tools.name: search_plans
tools.description:
Find plans. Give at least one of `name`, `ein`, `state` or `recordkeeper`; the other filters narrow
the list. Each result is a short summary: call `get_plan` with its `ein` and `pn` for the profile.

With `name`, results are ordered by match score, then size; without it, largest plans first. Plans

tools.name: get_plan_fees
tools.description:
For each large plan year: Schedule C pay by role (recordkeeping, advisory, participant advice, TPA,
investment management, trustee, other) in dollars and basis points of average net assets; every provider
on the Schedule C with names as filed, codes, direct and indirect pay; Schedule H line 2i expen

tools.name: find_plan_changes
tools.description:
Change events detected by comparing each plan's consecutive filings, newest filing first. Each event
has before/after values, a confidence, the year compared against, a plain-English detail and the ACK ID
of the filing that shows it.

tools.name: list_prospects
tools.description:
A list of plans for prospecting or research, many per call: plan and sponsor name, mailing address,
EIN and plan number, industry, plan type, effective (inception) date, participants and net assets at the
end of the latest plan year, form type, recordkeeper and primary advisor last seen on Schedule

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description:
What the data covers per plan year, every limitation, the coverage-note codes responses can carry,
the event types, the screening signals and the plan-type values. Free.

Also lists the prices and what isn't charged. Same data as GET /coverage of the Plan Data API.
